description_en: Submits a ticket to apply for gateway keys
description_zh: 提交网关密钥申请工单
name: SubmitGatewayTupleOrder

parameters.help_en: The number of gateway security keys to apply for
parameters.help_zh: 要申请的网关安全密钥的数量
parameters.name: required_count

parameters.help_en:
The gateway key type. Valid values:

singlechannel: low-speed edition (single-channel).

standard: Standard Edition.

hybrid: high-speed edition (Hybrid).

noncontractual: high-speed edition
parameters.help_zh:
网关密钥类型。

singlechannel：低速版（单通道型）。

standard：标准版。

hybrid：高速版（Hybrid型）。

noncontractual：高速版
parameters.name: tuple_type

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
